final_message:
Configured the 31 authoritative zones on pc1–pc31 as requested, with delegations, glue, A and MX records. pc32 (`10.15.8.14`) is the recursive resolver, and pc33–pc40 use it as clients.

Created BIND configuration and zone files and appended DNS startup commands. Existing images, addresses, routes and topology were preserved. Static checks passed for zone assignments, delegations, glue and startup shell syntax.

`www.example.com` points to pc33 (`10.15.9.11`) as an assumption: the baseline identifies no web-service host. BIND validation tools were unavailable locally, and live Kathara/DNS testing remains to be done.
